_comment: Shared sheet geometry (REBUILD_SPEC 3.2A). v2 adds answer_sheet.geometry (fiducials, timing marks, QR box, bubble grid). All mm, top-left origin. Row pitch is COMPUTED per (question count, N) by app/sheet_template.bubble_centres so any allowed quiz fits one page. Read by ingestion validation (Phase 2), the PDF renderer (Phase 4), the OMR pipeline (Phase 5/6). capacity_by_n stays at the R3.2 numbers pending a physical proof-print; a later <=15% tweak would be template_version 3.
